about: Evaluation-only diversity pools of pt-BR person names for multi-salon scenario generation (Secretaria reliability program). Hand-written common names; no real person, contact or pairing of a name with any other attribute.

Runtime code (src/lib, src/app, packages/salon-secretary/src) must never read or copy these pools: a name list inside the runtime would turn the evaluation into a keyword test. The unit test multi-salon-pools pins that no runtime file references this folder.

Every name appears once across female, male, unisex, compound, foreignOrigin and wordNames (accent and case folded). Surnames and nicknames are separate pools. Tags are defined in tagDefinitions; accent, particle and ambiguous are derived and checked.

Anti-overfitting: a generator must split every pool into dev and held parts with a seeded hash of the folded name (never by hand), keep names already present in the base fixture, the dev batteries or the example bank out of held measurements (or report them apart), and report pass rates per group and per tag.

Nicknames, spelling variants, honorific forms and wordNames change what a correct secretary must do (ask or show candidates, never auto-pick; tell a vocative from a customer; tell a name from a date or a service). They are never meaning-preserving noise: use them only in scenarios whose oracle states the expected behaviour.
relatesTo lists the folded words a name collides with or sounds like; meaning is a short pt-BR gloss of the common-word sense.

tagDefinitions.modern: more common among people born this century
tagDefinitions.accent: holds a diacritic or cedilla (derived: any combining mark after NFD); accent stripping by the noise generator keeps identity
tagDefinitions.particle: holds a particle (da, das, de, do, dos)
tagDefinitions.gender-trap: compound whose grammatical gender differs from its first element
tagDefinitions.near-temporal: sounds like or starts like a temporal word (see relatesTo)
tagDefinitions.word: is also a common pt-BR word
tagDefinitions.temporal: is, or derives from, a temporal word (see relatesTo)
tagDefinitions.number-like: is also an ordinal or number word (see relatesTo)
tagDefinitions.service-like: is, or starts like, a service word of salon-types.json (see relatesTo)
tagDefinitions.color: is also a color word (hair or nail color)
tagDefinitions.religious: Marian or religious name that is also a word
tagDefinitions.vocative-like: also used to address someone ("oi, flor"): may be read as a vocative instead of a customer
tagDefinitions.very-common: among the most frequent Brazilian surnames
tagDefinitions.nickname: nickname of one or more formal names
tagDefinitions.ambiguous: nickname of more than one formal name of the pools (derived)
tagDefinitions.familiar: familiar honorific used with customers (tia, tio)
